assumptions: P and Q are fixed compact full-dimensional convex 3-polytopes; every actual facet is used exactly once.
A fixed face-lattice correspondence identifies facets, edges and all nonsimple incident-facet sets.
Interior dihedral angles satisfy theta_P<=theta_Q at every corresponding edge.
An orientation-correcting orthogonal reflection of Q is allowed because it preserves all target angle and Gram data.
All sufficiently-large-lambda thresholds and geometric constants may depend on the fixed P,Q and chosen smooth cutoff/q.
Standard finite-dimensional convexity, smooth approximation, Lipschitz area/composition/extension and trace facts, and classification of maps S2 to S2 by degree are imported foundational results.
Only for the analytic interface: precisely the smooth-domain existence/energy statement (2.1) as written, on smooth convex bodies including flat patches.
candidate_stronger_claim: Weak interior-dihedral domination at every corresponding edge forces equality of the Gram matrices of all outward unit facet normals.
completion_qualification: 100 percent is completion of this assigned conditional geometry audit, not the entire candidate or a discovery/priority claim.
exact_original_target: For fixed corresponding edges of combinatorially equivalent compact full-dimensional convex 3-polytopes, some corresponding interior dihedral angle of P is no greater than that of Q.

excluded_degeneracies: exact source exterior angles 0 or pi at a purported edge
uniform estimates over all degenerating polytope families
negative_controls: remove hemisphere: geodesic endpoint operator norm exceeds one
reverse exterior angle comparison: edge nuclear norm expands
fixed relative-width cutoff: L2 error need not vanish
dimension-four cube: three active facets meet an edge, requiring more than vertex-only removal
falsification_and_boundaries.retained_finite_scale_counterexample_to_: 32 sampled points on the fixed valence-32 pyramid at lambda=64 have empty active common intersection; the claimed construction requires sufficiently large lambda depending on the fixed polytope.

mathematical_remaining_gap.outside_family_scope: This family has not independently verified the specialized smooth-domain Dirac statement (2.1), including flat-patch applicability, representation/index conventions, or the later analytic limit/Clifford steps. Those remain required for the whole proof; no whole-proof acceptance is asserted.
